shortDescription: Manage multiline banners on Cisco NXOS devices

options.name: banner
options.description: Specifies which banner that should be configured on the remote device.

options.name: multiline_delimiter
options.description: Specify the delimiting character than will be used for configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies whether or not the configuration is present in the current devices active running configuration.

options.name: text
options.description: The banner text that should be present in the remote device running configuration. This argument accepts a multiline string, with no empty lines. Requires I(state=present).
